why: Shell cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-1.md, P1 shell-1.1): `useDataTable({ detail })` is documented as the pairing of a table with `PageAside`, and it cannot be wired from a published subpath. The activation shows into the `DetailHost` that `<DataTable detail={…}>` receives (`src/table/parts/data-table.tsx:61`); the host `PageAside` serves is `DetailHostContext` (`src/page/page.tsx:46`), which no subpath exports and `DataTable` does not read. The entry's title is the table label (`src/table/use-data-table.ts:244`), so even a wired aside would read 'Checkout deploys' for every row. The build wrote a URL field, an `onRowActivate` and a boolean adapter instead (`apps/playground/src/cycle/shell-1/ServicesPage.tsx:68`).
what: A table row's `detail` opens in the page's `PageAside` with no wiring.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/page/page.tsx (only if the context needs an accessor)
their tests and one layout test
change: When `detail` is not passed, `DataTable` and its body read the enclosing `Page`'s detail host; outside a `Page` it keeps the sheet default. `useDataTable` takes `detailTitle?: (row) => string`, and the entry's title is that, else the table label. A layout test renders `AppShell > Page > DataTable` with `detail` and a `PageAside`, activates a row at 1800 px and asserts the aside shows the row's body under the row's title. The PR names the `cycle-shell-1: shell-1.1` workaround it makes removable.
acceptance: A row with `detail` opens its body in the page's `PageAside` under `AppShell` with no `detail` prop on `DataTable` (layout test)
The aside's title is `detailTitle(row)` when given
out_of_scope: The compact sheet (v3-shell-1-phone-aside); a string `state` on `PageAside` (v3-shell-1-api).
